source.author: Maurice Dunand
source.title: Nouvelle inscription découverte à Byblos
source.role: direct primary publication of first stele

object_assertions.surface: rear rough; inscribed face carefully dressed
object_assertions.condition: upper-left break removes ends of first four lines; additional minor edge damage
object_assertions.find_context: reused in lower courses of a cistern in later domestic construction near southwest corner; cistern floor about 3 m below ground surface
object_assertions.original_context: not in situ; Dunand cautiously associated its source with nearby reused architectural material and suggested possible Middle Kingdom antiquity

later_identifier.description: slab with ten lines of pseudo-hieroglyphic characters

method_notes: Find context is secondary reuse and must not be converted into secure original archaeological context.
Dunand's Middle Kingdom suggestion is an author hypothesis, not a fixed corpus date.
The Persée page exposes a copy/figure, but image redistribution rights are not inferred from public viewability.
